## What changed

Describe the user workflow, implementation, and visible behavior.

## Why

Explain the concrete evaluation or decision problem this change addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit and integration tests
- [ ] Linux and Windows behavior considered
- [ ] Repository audit
- [ ] Documentation or screenshots updated where relevant
- [ ] No API keys, private prompts, captured responses, or participant data

## Evidence boundary

State what the change can establish and what it still cannot establish. Note any
effect on blinding, randomization, identity reveal, or audit artifacts.

## Compatibility

- [ ] No schema or artifact-format changes
- [ ] Schema or artifact-format changes are versioned and documented
- [ ] Existing workspaces and browser-local data remain usable
